article.title: Administration to attorney of absent person entitled to administer in case of intestacy.
article.content: When a person entitled to administration in case of intestacy is absent from the State, and no person equally entitled is willing to act, letters of administration may be granted to the attorney or agent of the absent person, limited as mentioned in section 241.
article.html:
243Administration to attorney of absent person entitled to administer in case of intestacy.

Section 243 · Part IX · Chapter II · page 72 of the Act

When a person entitled to administration in case of intestacy is absent from the State, and no person equally entitled is willing to act, letters of administration may be granted to the attorney or agent of the absent person, limited as mentioned in section 241.
